purpose: Fifth permanent-unlock research pass: account passives, region achievement rewards and farm/base-camp perks that materially alter combat or region value. Convenience-only rewards and prices are omitted.

policy.ground_truth: Current RuneScape Wiki and direct/current 2026 Jagex patch material.
policy.pvme: Discovery only. Older PvME wording is corrected where account-passive behaviour changed after publication.
policy.league_overlay: Equilibrium region and quest overrides remain separate from these base-game acquisition rules.
policy.boss_scope: Boss-specific strategy remains excluded; generic account buffs and acquisition dependencies are in scope.

dungeoneering.name: Spirit cape passive
dungeoneering.effect: Permanently reduces familiar special-move point costs by 20% after the cape is purchased.
dungeoneering.league_treatment: Daemonheim/Dungeoneering already has a hard Forinthry planner dependency. League token multipliers change acquisition speed, not the permanent effect.

anachronia_base_camp.name: Slayer Lodge progression

tiers.benefit: +6% damage on Anachronia plus Slayer helmet stand

anachronia_base_camp.tier_3_passive: The Slayer helmet stand grants the effects of the placed Slayer helmet without wearing it; it does not grant the helmet's stats or teleports.

anachronia_base_camp.name: Player Lodge progression

tiers.benefit: +10% chance to find Anachronia building resources
Player Lodge restoration and Anachronia teletab support

anachronia_base_camp.tier_3_passive: The skillcape rack grants the passive perk of the placed skillcape without wearing it; activation-only cape effects are excluded.

farm_combat_perks.name: Player-owned farm combat perks
farm_combat_perks.category: account passive plus farm-totem upgrade state
farm_combat_perks.tier_1_account_rule: Completing an animal category's breeding log passively grants that animal's Tier 1 perk. This was added on 22 January 2024.
farm_combat_perks.tier_2_rule: Two qualifying elder animals in two farm-totem pens of the same size/species activate the Tier 2 effect. Anachronia has only one small and one medium pen, so those sizes cannot provide Tier 2 there.

records.name: NopeNopeNope
records.tier_1: 2% increased damage against all spiders, including Araxxor/Araxxi
records.tier_2: 3% increased damage against all spiders, including Araxxor/Araxxi

records.name: King of Beasts
records.tier_1: 5% chance to conserve a bomb when thrown
records.tier_2: 10% chance to conserve a bomb when thrown

records.name: No Fear
records.tier_1: 20% increased critical-hit chance for Meteor Strike
records.tier_2: 40% increased critical-hit chance for Meteor Strike

records.name: Armoured Hide
records.tier_1: Barricade duration increased by 3 ticks (1.8 seconds)
records.tier_2: Barricade duration increased by 6 ticks (3.6 seconds)

farm_combat_perks.league_treatment: Model permanent Tier 1 breeding-log unlocks separately from active Tier 2 farm-totem configuration. Do not require an occupied pen for Tier 1 after the breeding log is complete.

rewards.effect: The Lady of the Lake can enhance Excalibur.
Enhanced Excalibur healing has doubled duration.
Enchanted-bolt special-effect chance gains +2 percentage points additively.
10% more auto-attack damage and 5% more ability damage against the Dagannoth Kings.
5% increased damage against shadow creatures in Prifddinas.
5% increased damage against elves in Prifddinas.
5% chance not to consume a charge of an attuned crystal bow or attuned crystal ward.

region_achievement_passives.name: Hard Desert Keris upgrade
region_achievement_passives.effect: Against Kalphites and Scabarites, the Keris hit-chance bonus rises from 15% to 25% and its triple-damage chance rises from 2.5% to 5%.

rewards.effect: Prayer drain is halved in Barrows.
Barrows chest loot can be banked directly from the reward chest.

account_combat_infrastructure.name: Totem of Vitality
account_combat_infrastructure.effect: Increases maximum life points by 25%, capped at 1,500 additional life points.
account_combat_infrastructure.2026_change: The 13 April 2026 Aura Overhaul moved the former Might of Het effect to the Totem of Vitality and removed weekly totem charging/lockout upkeep.
account_combat_infrastructure.league_treatment: Store this as an Anachronia account unlock. Do not stack it with obsolete aura assumptions from Catalyst-era guides.

account_combat_infrastructure.name: Infernal Puzzle Box combat progression
account_combat_infrastructure.base_acquisition: Found in the Zamorakian Undercity or received through Daughter of Chaos.

milestones.effect: Adrenaline no longer drains outside combat while the box is carried.
The box can be added to the tool belt, making its carried effects persistent without an inventory slot.

account_combat_infrastructure.league_treatment: Apply official Equilibrium quest auto-completion separately. Do not infer a single ED4 region from physical location.

account_combat_infrastructure.name: Reaper Crew
account_combat_infrastructure.requirement: Complete the Reaper Crew achievement by defeating the required bosses.
account_combat_infrastructure.league_treatment: This is a cross-region completion goal, not a reason to create boss strategy data. Region availability should determine whether the achievement is completable in the League.
